crossRefs.note: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up…
I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them…
but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with Yahweh’s glory—
One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”
They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of Yahweh, as the…
For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of Yahweh’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.
Yahweh will be King over all the earth. In that day Yahweh will be one, and his name one.
For from the rising of the sun even to its going down, my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense…
Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory…
Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
Blessed be Yahweh forever more. Amen, and Amen.
and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels, and make your body swell, and your thigh fall away.” The…
Benaiah the son of Jehoiada answered the king, and said, “Amen. May Yahweh, the God of my lord the king, say so.
even the prophet Jeremiah said, “Amen! May Yahweh do so. May Yahweh perform your words which you have prophesied, to…
and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.
He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I come quickly.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus.

translations.web: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
